pages.text: Lulu was a little mail turtle. Every morning, she carried letters around the big pond.
One morning, a special letter came. It was for Grandma Mouse. “Today is her birthday!” said Lulu.
Grandma Mouse lived on the far side of the pond. Lulu started to walk. Walk, walk, walk.
“You are too slow!” laughed Rabbit. “Give me the letter. I can run fast!”
“No, thank you,” said Lulu. “A mail turtle carries her own mail.” And she walked on.
“Give it to me!” called Crow. “I can fly over the pond!” “No, thank you,” said Lulu.
Then rain fell. Drip, drop! Lulu hid the letter under her shell. It stayed warm and dry.
The rain stopped. A big hill stood in the way. Lulu climbed and climbed. She did not stop.
At sunset, Lulu came to Grandma Mouse's door. She knocked. “Mail for you, Grandma Mouse!”
Grandma Mouse opened the letter. It was from her grandchildren. “Happy birthday, Grandma! We love you!”
Grandma Mouse smiled and smiled. “This is the best gift,” she said. “Thank you, Lulu.”
That night, they ate warm cheese cake together. Slow and steady Lulu felt very happy.
